title: Excavations in Palestine in 1931-2: Masada
author: (round-up; survey by A. Schulten, A. Lammerer, Borée)
location_note: Masada; no map reference; placed by name. The last sentence concerns a plan of Battir (Z4).
notes: March 1932 survey: maps and plans of the fortress, the Palace of Herod and the nine Roman camps; plan of the fortress of Battir and its Roman circumvallation. Fortifications and camps not eligible; no eligible feature named.
